title: Designing Agentic AI-Based Screening for Portfolio Investment
abstract: arXiv:2603.23300v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce a new agentic artificial intelligence (AI) platform for portfolio management. Our architecture consists of three layers. First, two large language model (LLM) agents are assigned specialized tasks: one agent screens for firms with desirable fundamentals, while a sentiment analysis agent screens for firms with desirable news. Second, these agents deliberate to generate and agree upon buy and sell signals from a large portfolio, substantially narrowing the pool of candidate assets. Finally, we apply a high-dimensional precision matrix estimation procedure to determine optimal portfolio weights. We show, through information acquisition theory, that screening with agentic AI can bring utility gains in screening compared with humans. We introduce the concept of \emph{sensible screening} and establish that, under mild screening errors, the squared Sharpe ratio of the screened portfolio consistently estimates its target.

translated_title: 设计基于代理型人工智能的投资组合筛选系统
translated_abstract: 我们引入了一个用于投资组合管理的全新代理型人工智能平台。我们的架构由三个层次组成。首先，两个大型语言模型代理被分配了专门任务：一个代理筛选具有理想基本面的公司，而情感分析代理则筛选具有积极新闻的公司。其次，这些代理通过协商生成并一致同意从大型投资组合中产生买入和卖出信号，大幅缩小候选资产的范围。最后，我们应用高维精度矩阵估计程序来确定最优投资组合权重。通过信息获取理论，我们展示了与人类相比，使用代理型AI进行筛选可以带来效用提升。我们引入了“明智筛选”的概念，并证明在轻微筛选误差下，筛选后投资组合的平方夏普比率一致地估计其目标值。
tldr: 本文提出一个三层架构的代理型AI投资组合筛选平台，通过LLM代理分工筛选和协商，结合高维精度矩阵优化权重，理论上证明了其在筛选效用和夏普比率估计上的优势。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a three-layer agentic AI platform for portfolio screening, using LLM agents for specialized screening and deliberation, plus high-dimensional precision matrix weighting, theoretically showing utility gains and consistent Sharpe ratio estimation.
